info.subtitle: What to expect when wax needs clearing

rows.title: Ears clean themselves
rows.desc: Wax usually migrates out on its own

rows.desc: Cotton swabs pack wax deeper into the canal

rows.title: Signs of a blockage
rows.desc: Muffled hearing, fullness, mild ache or ringing

rows.title: Protects your devices
rows.desc: Clear wax keeps hearing aids working well
